description: Get detailed information about a specific medication including: all available dosage strengths and titration schedules, available forms (injectable vials, pre-filled syringes, oral dissolving tablets, sublingual drops), all active plan options with pricing for each, what's included (provider consultation, medication, shipping, ongoing support), contraindications, and common side effects. Supports queries by medication name (e.g. 'semaglutide', 'tirzepatide', 'sermorelin', 'NAD+', 'glutathione') or by category (e.g. 'weight loss', 'peptides', 'anti-aging'). Use this to look up exact plan durations and pricing.
